name: Salute
summary: Sitting on the long box facing the footbar, tipped forward on a flat diagonal, hands start at the forehead and the arms press out along that line.
steps: Sit on the long box facing the footbar, body hinged forward with a straight spine.
Short loops in the hands, elbows bent wide, fingertips at the forehead.
Breathe out to straighten the elbows without moving the upper arms.

layers.title: Kneeling
layers.text: Sit on the heels, then kneel upright (hard).

layers.title: Elbows forward
layers.text: Point the elbows ahead for a straight triceps press.

cautions.note: Keep the weight light and the gaze down.

cues:
The forward tilt doesn't change.
Head stays in line — don't let it drop.
Shoulders away from the ears.
